population.span: Men and women aged between 18 and 80 years suffering from primary insomnia according to the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual for Mental Disorders (DSM-IV) criteria with sleep latency longer than 20 min were included in the study.

endpoint.span: Effects of 3 weeks treatment with prolonged release melatonin (PRM) and placebo on sleep diary-recorded sleep latency in the low excretors and the elderly patients.

ci.span: whereas a significant difference in favour of PRM was found for patients aged 65-80 years (-15.6 min; 95% CI -25.3 to -6.0, P = 0.002; Table ; Figure ).

analysis_set.span: The number of patients in the low excretors (86 per treatment group) and 65-80 year-old subgroups (PRM 137; placebo 144) of the FAS was lower than planned.

treatment_strategy.span: patients were randomized to receive PRM (Circadin ® 2 mg, Neurim Pharmaceuticals Ltd, Tel Aviv, Israel) or placebo, given orally as one tablet per day 2 h before bedtime

follow_up.span: The effects of 3 weeks treatment with PRM or placebo on patient reported sleep latency (sleep diary) for low excretors and elderly patients are shown in Table .

served_mismatch: The served means, SDs and sample sizes match the age 65-80 subgroup at 3 weeks. The label 'completers efficacy set' is unsupported: the article identifies this subgroup as FAS and the registry explicitly identifies a pre-planned ITT analysis. 'End of treatment' must specify the initial 3-week period, rather than the extension ending at week 29. The bound MD and CI are the reported adjusted treatment effect, not a simple subtraction of the change means.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Entry criteria match the broad question about adults with primary insomnia, but include ages 18-80 rather than only the served age 65-80 subgroup.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Men and women aged between 18 and 80 years suffering from primary insomnia according to the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual for Mental Disorders (DSM-IV) criteria with sleep latency longer than 20 min were included in the study.

notes: All field spans use held full text. The registry corroborates the analysis designation with 'POPULATION: Pre-planned analysis on ITT population age 65-80'. No numerical candidate was rejected; the served descriptive statistics are correct. The reported CI belongs to the adjusted MD.
